emails.subject: [Action may be required] PayGate TLS certificate chain migration - effective 2026-10-08
emails.body: PayGate is migrating api.paygate.example to a new certificate chain: leaf issued by 'PayGate Issuing CA G3' under new root 'PayGate Global Root R2'. Rollout is rolling across edge nodes during the maintenance window 2026-10-08 09:00-11:00 UTC. Customers using the operating-system or browser trust store need no action. Customers who PIN certificates or maintain a CUSTOM TRUSTSTORE must add Root R2 (SHA-256 fingerprint published at https://pki.paygate.example/r2) before 2026-10-08. Sandbox migrates on 2026-10-22.

emails.subject: Reminder: PayGate TLS chain migration in 14 days
emails.body: Reminder of EML-001. Pinned/custom-truststore clients must add Root R2 before 2026-10-08.
